title: Representing Data: Scatter Plots, Histograms and Pie Charts
seo_title: Grade 9 Representing Data Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Draw a variety of graphs by hand or technology to display and interpret data, including bar graphs and double bar graphs, histograms with given and own intervals, pie charts, broken-line graphs and scatter plots; critically read and interpret data represented in a variety of ways.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 9 worksheets: scatter plots, correlation, lines of best fit, histograms and pie charts. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A scatter plot shows two sets of data. Positive correlation: both increase; negative: one increases as the other decreases.
  • A line of best fit follows the trend and can be used to estimate values inside the data range.
  • An outlier is a point far from the others.
  • Pie chart: angle = fraction × 360°.

Examples

Example

Hours studied and test marks rise together

points go up to the right

Answer: positive correlation

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Correlation is causeIt does not prove one causes the other.
Far outside the dataEstimate only inside the range.
100 for a pie chartUse 360°.

items.e: A circle graph is a whole circle, and a full turn is 360°. (100 is for percents.)

items.q: A sector is 25% of a circle graph. What is its angle?
items.e: 25% × 360° = 0,25 × 360° = 90°. A sector of 25% is NOT 25°: it is one-quarter of the circle, a right angle.

items.q: A sector is 50% of a circle graph. What is its angle?
A sector is 10% of a circle graph. What is its angle?
A sector is 20% of a circle graph. What is its angle?
A sector is 35% of a circle graph. What is its angle?
items.e: 35% × 360° = 0,35 × 360° = 126°. (12,6° puts the decimal point in the wrong place.)

items.q: A sector is 15% of a circle graph. What is its angle?
A sector is 12,5% of a circle graph. What is its angle?
items.e: 12,5% × 360° = 0,125 × 360° = 45°. Check: 12,5% is 18, and 360 ÷ 8 = 45.

items.q: A sector of a circle graph has an angle of 90°. What percent is it?
items.e: 90° ÷ 360° = 0,25 = 25%. (90% reads the degrees as a percent.)
